points.why: It maps each theory to its structure: a fixed limit, underinvestment with flat sales read as proof, several simultaneous limits, and a shared commons of town tolerance.
It names separating evidence: stockout logs and lost sales, the history of the no-demand decisions, which peak limit binds first, and whether the other breweries are also flat.
It ties a different remedy to each theory (plan around, test capacity cheaply, sequence the limits, agree joint strip rules) and says several are likely operating together.
Its recommendations target capacity, peak constraints and a collective noise agreement, not marketing.

pitfalls.why: It never suggests more marketing or promotions.
